preconditions.description: The number of junctions n must be between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(-10000 <= s_i <= 10000 for s_i in s)
preconditions.description: Each junction's constraint s_i must be between -10,000 and 10,000.
The number of pipes m must be between 0 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x_i <= n and 1 <= y_i <= n and x_i != y_i for x_i, y_i in pipes)
preconditions.description: Each pipe must connect two distinct junctions within the valid range.

postconditions.description: Output 'Possible' if the sum of all junction constraints is zero, otherwise output 'Impossible'.
Each pipe setting f_i must be an integer within the range of -2 billion to 2 billion.
The number of pipe settings f must equal the number of pipes m.
